messages:
jess: Heads up — two enterprise customers filed tickets saying routes sometimes land in the 'accelerator' pool and show a lower per-route quota than expected. Console displays a per-route override but doesn't clearly show how that interacts with account-level caps. I'm proposing an 'Effective Access Preview' panel in the console that shows computed grants (actions allowed), routing affinity (which pools a request will prefer), and the effective quota window for a given route + principal. We also need an API for previews and telemetry. Thoughts? :eyes:

omkar: Strong +1. We already compute effective access in authz but it's split across services. Main perf concern: if the UI hits this on hover for many rows, we need caching or a very cheap precompute path.

kevin: Backend sketch: POST /v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/access_preview body {route, principal, simulate_overrides:true}. Response: allowed_actions[], routing_affinity:[{pool,score}], quota:{limit,remaining,reset_ts}, source_breakdown:[account,route,policy], audit_id. Cache per (tenant,principal,route,policy_version) with short TTL; invalidate on policy change. Also add rate limits for console-originating calls.

lia: Product: need UX mocks and deterministic language for "why" a decision happened (compliance requires an audit_id tied to logs). Rollout should be feature-flag gated and enterprise tenants should be able to opt-out of telemetry.

sara: Design: compact summary line with an expand option. Hide raw policy text by default; offer "View audit trace" that expands the contributing rules. Microcopy suggestion: "Effective access is computed from tenant policies and route overrides. View audit trace to see the contributing rules." :memo:

kevin: Telemetry plan: events - access_preview.view (panel opened), access_preview.api_call (API used), access_preview.result_cached (bool). Include properties: tenant_id, principal_id, route, result_source:cache|computed, audit_id, latency_ms, preview_mode:ui|api. Keep cardinality low.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: feature-flag 'access_preview' created (default: off). Canary rollout target: 10%.

jess: Rollout plan: internal tenants + one friendly customer first. Collect feedback on clarity of routing explanation and whether quota numbers match expectations. Owners?

omkar: I'll own the backend implementation. Notes: cache key = sha256(tenant + principal + route + policy_version). Expose policy_version and audit_id in response so UI can warn if stale. Also add a pre-warm endpoint for a batch of (principal,route) pairs to reduce first-hit latency for dashboards.

lia: I'll own product rollout and coordinate docs + support for the friendly customer.

kevin: Also propose a lightweight health check endpoint for the preview API so the console can fall back to "Unable to compute preview" without blocking the page render. And surface a "stale" badge if cache_age > threshold.

sara: Microcopy tweak: "This preview shows the effective permissions and quota for the selected route, derived from tenant policies and route overrides. Click ‘View audit trace’ to inspect contributing rules." Keep copy short and consistent with other console language.

jess: Next steps: (1) omkar/kevin 1-week spike to land API + cache layer, (2) lia/sara mock and microcopy, (3) enable feature-flag in infra and 10% canary, (4) validate with 2 customers, (5) define rollback plan. Tagging @kevin @omkar for action items. :thumbsup:
